description.la: Apologia Bernardi ad Guillelmum abbatem sancti Theoderici, in qua et Cluniacensium abusus et Cisterciensium aemulationem reprehendit.
description.en-US: Bernard’s letter-treatise to William of Saint-Thierry, defending the Cistercians against the charge of disparaging Cluny, and attacking the luxury and the monastic art of the Black Monks (the famous passage on cloister sculpture), with Mabillon’s admonitio. Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A carta-tratado de Bernardo a Guilherme de Saint-Thierry, em defesa dos cistercienses contra a acusação de desprezar Cluny, e crítica do luxo e da arte monástica (a famosa passagem sobre a escultura dos claustros).

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), work 6148, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with Mabillon’s admonitio, chapter headings and summaries. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
